# 效果 J-L

## kill_country_leader

Kills a country leader and removes him completely, making the next in line the new party and country leader.

作用域：`country`

```ts
"kill_country_leader"(value: boolean): void;
```

CWT 来源：

- [Config/effects.cwt:1266](https://github.com/cwtools/cwtools-hoi4-config/blob/master/Config/effects.cwt#L1266)

## kill_ideology_leader

Removes a ideology leader as leader of his party, making the next in line the new party leader.

作用域：`COUNTRY`

```ts
"kill_ideology_leader"(value: string): void;
"kill_ideology_leader"(value: number): void;
```

CWT 来源：

## kill_operative

Kills an operative. This will temporarily lock the slot they occupy.

作用域：`COUNTRY`、`operative`

```ts
"kill_operative"(value: CwtOpaque): void;
"kill_operative"(value: { "operative": CwtOpaque } | CwtNode): void;
"kill_operative"(value: { "killed_by": CountryRef } | CwtNode): void;
```

CWT 来源：
